rubric_source: FlytBase AI Engineer assignment requirements + weighted assessment metrics

requirement_checks.title: Feature spec exists with value + key requirements
requirement_checks.evidence: Feature spec language found in README.
requirement_checks.why_it_matters: Assignment explicitly asks for a short feature spec.
requirement_checks.recommendation: Add a dedicated 'Feature Spec' section: value proposition + 3 measurable requirements.

requirement_checks.title: Architecture/design artifact present
requirement_checks.why_it_matters: Design/architecture carries report and documentation weight.
requirement_checks.recommendation: Populate architecture with data flow, storage, alert flow, and reasoning loop.

requirement_checks.title: Prototype development pipeline implemented
requirement_checks.why_it_matters: Core pipeline functionality is foundational to correctness.
requirement_checks.recommendation: Ensure all stages are reproducible in a single command/script.

requirement_checks.title: Cross-domain frame indexing implemented
requirement_checks.why_it_matters: Cross-domain requirement is explicitly mandatory in assignment.
requirement_checks.recommendation: Keep query examples in report showing object/time retrieval.

requirement_checks.title: QA test cases are robust and reproducible
requirement_checks.evidence: Test suite appears robust and self-contained.
requirement_checks.why_it_matters: Assignment requires QA scenarios; weak tests reduce confidence and score.
requirement_checks.recommendation: Replace stubs with assertive tests and use FastAPI TestClient instead of external server.
